requirements: Non-IC application and manufacturer insulation clearance; not a substitution for IC new-construction housing.

allowances.basis: Five Ketra S30 decorative trim-only finishes in the supplied workbook are each $82.50 cost / $150 list. This is a cross-family budget allowance, not an exact D2R supplier quote or a part substitution.
